p: It is brought in the holy sefer Avodas Yisrael
on the statement of our Sages, of blessed memory
than the day on which the Torah was given,
as it says, 'My teaching shall drop like the rain'
who is made dependent on whom," et cetera,
to the day of Shemini Atzeres,
which is called the day of rain,
since on it we bless for rain.
That is because concerning the day of Shemini Atzeres
it is brought in the Tikkunim
that on it is the wellspring of the Torah;
and it is the aspect of the novel insight
and it is the aspect of the watering of the Tree
(הַקְדָּמַת תִּקּוּנֵי זֹהַר, פָּתַח אֵלִיָּהוּ, יז, א)
the aspect of the Written Torah,
which is called the Tree of Life:
"It is a tree of life to those who grasp it"
and the yearning to come from it
to the aspect of the Written Torah,
"For as the rain comes down, etc.,
that goes forth from My mouth;
it shall not return to Me empty,
"My word that goes forth from My mouth"
is the aspect of the Oral Torah,
and it is called like rain
and makes it bring forth and sprout.
And it is a borrowed term
for every root of the source of blessing,
"And it will be, if you diligently listen
I will give the rain of your land in its season, etc."
"I will give your rains in their season, etc."
And also in the generation of the Flood,
all the fountains of the great deep burst forth,
and the windows of the heavens were opened"
and the hint to this is brought
that the gate of wisdom was opened Above
and the wellspring of wisdom below.
For in truth at that time
for the bestowal of the wisdoms of the Torah,
had the generation been worthy of it,
as is known from the holy sefarim.
And to this our Sages, of blessed memory, hinted
that great is the day of rain,
namely, the day of Shemini Atzeres,
on which is the wellspring of the Torah,
more than the day on which was given
That is because on the day of Shemini Atzeres
the source of renewal of the Torah is opened
"My teaching shall drop like the rain."
and it is made dependent on the rain,
of the renewal of words of Torah,

paragraphs.text: R. Yisrael of Kozhnitz, Avodas Yisrael, Shemini Atzeres — “In Taanis: ‘Great is the day of rain like the day the Torah was given, as it says, “My lesson (likchi) shall drop as the rain” (Devarim 32:2)… Rava said: more than the day the Torah was given.’ This alludes to the festival of Shemini Atzeres, which they called ‘the day of rain’ because on it we bless ‘Who makes the rain fall’… Therefore Chazal alluded: ‘Great is the day of rain’ — Shemini Atzeres — ‘like the day the Torah was given,’ which is Shavuos; but Rava disagreed and said its level is greater, for on it the Oral Torah drips down drop by drop, as is known.”

paragraphs.text: Taanis 7a — "Rav Yehudah said: The day of rain is as great as the day the Torah was given… Rava said: Greater than the day the Torah was given, as it says, 'My teaching (likchi) shall drop like the rain' (Devarim 32:2) — who is compared to whom? The lesser is compared to the greater." Rashi: the verse compares teaching to rain.

paragraphs.text: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13, 29b — "Shemini Atzeres is a festival in its own right; on it is the welling forth of the Torah, to water the tree that is planted in the garden, and its roots and branches are like the circle (chug) of the earth, for all the festivals are celebrated in it."

paragraphs.text: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a — “You brought forth ten arrangements, and we call them ten sefirot, through which to direct concealed worlds that are not revealed and worlds that are revealed. ... Malkhut is the mouth: we call it Oral Torah.” The specific formula “Malkhut is the mouth, Oral Torah” is found in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar, in Patach Eliyahu. It complements the preceding Zohar passage about the seventh day.

paragraphs.text: Zohar I 117a (Vayera) — "And in the six hundredth year of the sixth [millennium] the gates of wisdom above and the springs of wisdom below will be opened, and the world will be prepared to enter the seventh… and your sign: 'In the six hundredth year of Noach's life… all the springs of the great deep were split open' (Bereishis 7:11)."
